partial_frozen_A_assessment.probability_metric: Brier on event 'positive change' for numeric targets; hike occurs for binary targets
partial_frozen_A_assessment.interpretation: In the first six completed A targets, the simple numerical/market benchmark beats both LLM and hybrid probabilities. ISM manufacturing accelerated unexpectedly, WEI rose and claims fell, contradicting cautious LLM macro drift; services PMI decline matched the LLM center exactly. Two central-bank hike probabilities were already high in all three arms. Tiny heterogeneous sample; no statistical significance.
partial_frozen_A_assessment.caveats: Preliminary, release-time vignettes. First-vintage source audit remains incomplete for claims; WEI earlier release provenance requires archived version. 50% and 90% coverage not empirically calibrated. Brier mixes different events; report per-target values and refrain from calling them independent. No aggregate point MAE across units.
